english.title: Fail to maintain record of conventionally reared meat chickens in each house - Wales
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were responsible for conventionally reared meat chickens at **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), when, without lawful authority or excuse,

(A)_[you, being the keeper,]_
(B)_[the keeper, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),]_did not maintain, for each house, a record of the number of chickens introduced, the usable area, the hybrid or breed of the chickens (if known), the number of chickens found dead, with an indication of the causes (if known), as well as the number of chickens culled with cause, on each inspection and the number of chickens remaining in the flock following the removal of chickens for sale or slaughter in that **(..SPECIFY RECORD NOT MAINTAINED..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(1)(ba), 7(1)(a) and 9 of, and paragraph 13(1) of Schedule 5A to, the Welfare of Farmed Animals (Wales) Regulations 2007.

other.penalty:
Summary: 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
